title: Set-Off of the Cancellation Charge Against a Replacement Deposit — Pre-Orders & Back-Orders Desk Card
content:
**Rule.** The cancellation charge kept on a Pre-Orders & Back-Orders Deposit Pre-Order that is being replaced is set off against the replacement deposit. That charge is the amount-kept entry on its history, its forfeited deposit entry. The share set off depends on when the replacement is taken, counted from that reservation's cancellation date:

| Replacement taken, days after the cancellation date of the reservation replaced | Share of the charge kept that is set off |
|---|---|
| Within 7 days | 40 percent |
| From 8 days up to 30 days | 20 percent |
| Later than 30 days | 0 percent |

Days are calendar days from the cancellation date to the day the replacement is taken. The set-off is subtracted from the amount that the replacement deposit percentage gives on the price, before the floor on the replacement deposit applies.

**Edges**

| Days | Share set off |
|---|---|
| 7 | 40 percent |
| 8 | 20 percent |
| 30 | 20 percent |
| 31 | 0 percent |

**Desk example (hypothetical).** The charge kept on the reservation replaced was $35.00, and the replacement is taken 3 days after its cancellation. The set-off is 40 percent of $35.00, which is $14.00, subtracted from the amount the percentage gives on the price.
